content.short: Apexaverse is a decentralized P2E game built on the Cardano Blockchain.
content.description: Apexaverse is a decentralized P2E game built on the Cardano Blockchain. We will make it available as a Browser-Based Game and an Android/iOS app where players can compete in different worlds and realms, earning collectibles as Non-Fungible Tokens (NFTs) along the way. The game will be powered by our utility token called AXV. Apexaverse aims to be the best Metaverse and Web 3.0-focused game on the blockchain, allowing its users to enjoy being part of a limitless universe, the excitement of strategic gameplay, and crypto earning possibilities.
